summary.en: Use source locations, compilation stamps, and standard-version macros without confusing build time with run time.
summary.bn: সোর্সের অবস্থান, কম্পাইলের সময় আর সি স্ট্যান্ডার্ডের ম্যাক্রো ব্যবহার করো, বিল্ডের সময়কে রান টাইম ভেবো না।

notes: These programs target C17 and assume __STDC_VERSION__ is available. C89 has no such revision macro; wider compatibility code must check its existence. Source and translation-stamp macros are longstanding standard features.

practice.title: Print a controlled source diagnostic
practice.statementHtml: Read mark from 0 to 100. Print Mark value: then practice-marks.c:300 value=N using REPORT on the line immediately after the supplied #line directive.
hints: Source macros expand where REPORT is called.

practice.title: Distinguish source lines from loop iterations
practice.statementHtml: Read count from 0 to 5. Print Diagnostic count: then count lines containing zero-based iteration and source line 50 separated by a space. Place the same printf after #line 50 in the loop.
hints: The source line stays fixed across runtime iterations.

practice.title: Choose the C17 label
practice.statementHtml: Read score from 0 to 100. Print Build score: then C17: N when __STDC_VERSION__ is at least 201710L, otherwise Older: N. Compile in C17 mode.
hints: A version macro describes the build mode, not the score.

practice.title: Display build-stamp shapes on request
practice.statementHtml: Read enabled as 0 or 1. Print Show build stamp: then 11 8 if enabled, otherwise hidden. Obtain lengths from the predefined date and time string literals.
hints: sizeof includes a terminating null character.

examQuestions.question: Distinguish __DATE__ and __TIME__ from runtime clock information.
examQuestions.answerHtml: The macros expand to translation-context string literals stored in the executable. Re-running that executable keeps them unchanged. A runtime clock API is needed for current execution time.

examQuestions.question: Explain source-location capture in a diagnostic macro, including #line and build-path variation.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A macro containing __FILE__ and __LINE__ expands those context values where the macro is used. #line can change the presumed following line and file. Without such control, file spelling may depend on source paths and toolchain options. Include useful context in diagnostics while avoiding unnecessary path or timestamp dependence in stable output.

marks.c:200 value=17

The macro use follows #line 200 and receives the value seventeen.
